references.text: Jesus instructs the women, just as the angel did, to tell the disciples to go to Galilee to see him.
The angel rolls away the stone from the tomb and tells the women that Jesus has risen, paralleling the angel's message in Matthew.
The angel tells the women that Jesus is going ahead of them to Galilee, similar to the instructions given in Matthew.
The angel reminds the women of Jesus' words about his death and resurrection, parallel to the angel's message in Matthew.
